name: Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences
description: Enables the Group Policy 'Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences' (Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > Cloud Content) by setting DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures = 1 (REG_DWORD) in HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent. Only effective on Enterprise and Education editions.
rationale: Stops consumer-oriented experiences such as Start suggestions, membership notifications and post-setup app installs and redirect tiles, which add promotional content and unrequested apps.
effects: Users no longer see personalized recommendations from Microsoft and notifications about their Microsoft account.
Consumer experiences such as Start suggestions and post-setup app installs are turned off.
sideEffects: Microsoft account notifications (for example reminders to finish setting up the account) are not shown.
Applies to every user account on the device.
notes: Policy definition CloudContent.admx, policy DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures (class Machine): enabled value 1, disabled value 0.
The policy explanation states that it only applies to Enterprise and Education SKUs, and the Policy CSP (Experience/AllowWindowsConsumerFeatures) lists it as not applicable to Pro.
Requires Administrator rights (the value is stored under HKLM).
